verdict.rationale: Foreloop runs fixed, built-in event-triggered actions: pushing to a PR triggers an automatic review, an admin can set a failure threshold, feedback submissions route to a chosen project, and an agent auto-drafts an intention and tasks from each report. Users can also script their own automation through the CLI from cron or CI. There is no user-definable rules engine (custom triggers, conditions and actions) in the evidence, so the story's core of defining your own rules is only glancingly met. Missing for 10: a user-defined event→action rule builder, custom triggers and conditions, webhooks or event subscriptions, and independent corroboration.
